name: payforge
description: PayForge: a Stripe/Razorpay-style payment gateway built from scratch with NestJS microservices, Kafka, PostgreSQL and Redis.

scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis redpanda
scripts.infra:up:all: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile observability --profile tools up -d
scripts.infra:down: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile observability --profile tools --profile apps down
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile observability --profile tools --profile apps down -v
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix web/dashboard run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix sdk/payforge-js run build && npm --prefix web/checkout run build && npm --prefix web/dashboard run build
